metadata.name: polaris
metadata.description: Polaris on Solana: pay now, Pay in 4 against an on-chain credit line, send by link, daily check-in with SKR rewards

instructions.name: cancel_link
docs: The sender takes an unclaimed link back.

instructions.name: check_in
docs: The daily loop: one check-in per UTC day. Builds a streak, pays SKR
from the rewards vault (base x min(streak, 7)) and adds a score point
(the first CHECKIN_SCORE_CAP of them).

instructions.name: claim_link
docs: Claim a link. Signed by the link key, which also pays the fee and the
recipient's token-account rent, so the recipient needs no SOL.

accounts.name: link_key
docs: The link key signs and pays: the recipient needs no SOL.

instructions.name: collect_due
docs: Permissionless crank: collect a due instalment through the buyer's
delegate approval. Fails if nothing is due yet.

instructions.name: create_link
docs: Send by link: escrow dollars under an ephemeral link key. The secret
of that key travels in the link; whoever holds it can claim.

accounts.name: link_key
docs: travels in the link and must sign the claim.

instructions.name: faucet
docs: Devnet only: mint test dollars (pUSD) or stand-in SKR to the caller.

instructions.name: fund_pool
docs: Anyone can add dollars to the credit pool that funds Pay in 4.

instructions.name: fund_rewards
docs: Anyone can top up the SKR rewards vault the daily check-in pays from.

instructions.name: init_profile
docs: A buyer's credit record. Starts at STARTING_SCORE.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Create the config and the three vaults. The two mints are passed in:
on devnet they are stand-ins whose mint authority is the config PDA
(so the faucet works); on mainnet they would be USDC and SKR.

instructions.name: lock_skr
docs: Lock SKR to raise the Pay in 4 limit (SKR as credit collateral).

instructions.name: open_plan
docs: Pay in 4: the pool pays the merchant the full price now; the buyer owes
four instalments (principal + 10% APR pro-rated), nothing due today.
The buyer also approves the config PDA as delegate for what they owe,
so a crank can collect due instalments (Solana's stand-in for the
ERC-2612 permits and the CRE collections workflow on Monad).

instructions.name: pay
docs: Pay now: dollars straight from the buyer to the merchant.

instructions.name: repay_installment
docs: The buyer pays their next instalment (early counts as on time).

instructions.name: repay_with_skr
docs: Pay the next instalment in SKR instead of dollars, at the config's SKR
price. The SKR goes to the rewards vault, so what buyers spend funds
the next day's check-in rewards. (On mainnet a treasury job would swap
a share to USDC through Jupiter to refill the pool; not built.)

instructions.name: set_params
docs: Admin: tune the knobs (pause new Pay in 4 plans, SKR price stand-in,
instalment interval, grace, daily reward, faucet).

instructions.name: unlock_skr
docs: Unlock SKR, unless what stays locked would no longer cover the debt.

errors.name: FaucetDisabled
errors.msg: The faucet is off on this network

errors.name: FaucetCap
errors.msg: Faucet amount above the per-call cap

errors.name: WrongVault
errors.msg: Not the vault this instruction funds

errors.name: CreditPaused
errors.msg: New Pay in 4 plans are paused

errors.name: CollateralInUse
errors.msg: That SKR backs what you owe

fields.name: skr_price_micros
docs: USD price of 1 SKR in micro-dollars. Stand-in for an oracle feed.

fields.name: skr_collateral_bps
docs: Share of locked SKR's value that counts toward the limit (bps).

fields.name: checkin_reward
docs: SKR paid for a check-in at streak 1 (base units).
